title: polybotrya rhizophylla
intro: Polybotrya rhizophylla, commonly known as the "tiger fern," is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Polybotrya rhizophylla are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and antiparasitic activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
